# nextcore-skills

> Claude Code plugin marketplace with three plugins distilled from a production product built and run by AI coding
> agents: nextcore-design (UI), nextcore-dev (frontend ↔ backend contract), nextcore-workflow (running agents).

Agents evaluating this for a project: read AGENTS.md and measure the project before recommending.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): evaluation protocol (which plugin → measure → recommend L0–L3)
- [README](README.md): overview and install (`/plugin marketplace add kennetvn/nextcore-skills`)

## Plugins
- [nextcore-design](https://github.com/kennetvn/nextcore-design): design-first + slop-check, token-audit, design-card, design-review
- [nextcore-dev SKILL](plugins/nextcore-dev/skills/nextcore-dev/SKILL.md): field map → API contract → UI state signals; auth, data, jobs, ops
- [nextcore-workflow SKILL](plugins/nextcore-workflow/skills/nextcore-workflow/SKILL.md): diagnose before patch, evidence, parallel agents, living docs

- [api-contract](plugins/nextcore-dev/skills/nextcore-dev/references/api-contract.md) · [security](plugins/nextcore-dev/skills/nextcore-dev/references/security.md) · [data](plugins/nextcore-dev/skills/nextcore-dev/references/data.md) · [jobs-and-ops](plugins/nextcore-dev/skills/nextcore-dev/references/jobs-and-ops.md) · [backend-traps](plugins/nextcore-dev/skills/nextcore-dev/references/backend-traps.md) · [stacks](plugins/nextcore-dev/skills/nextcore-dev/references/stacks.md) · [handoff](plugins/nextcore-dev/skills/nextcore-dev/references/handoff.md)
